text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle won. She expressed her 
gratitude, saying her Trainer's cheers 
filled in for the resolve she lacked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the joy was short-lived. The next 
high-profile GⅠ, the Takarazuka Kinen, 
would feature a powerhouse lineup—Symboli 
Kris S and many more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City, the romantic front-runner. 
Agnes Digital, who doesn't care whether 
it's turf or dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite trembling with fear, supported by 
the Trainer's voice, she decided to aim 
for the Takarazuka Kinen.
